## Benefit Enrollments

*The benefitEnrollments resource includes a list of all active enrollments. It identifies the plans or options-in-plans in which a participant is enrolled, either through explicit elections or due to default or automatic enrollments. The resource always identifies a plan and the life event reason. In this context, the enrollment might be due to open enrollment. Where applicable, the elected program and option are identified.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments` | Get all enrollments |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}` | Get an enrollment |

## Benefit Enrollments/Costs

*The costs resource is a child of the benefitEnrollments resource. It includes amounts, tax consequences and other information about standard rates, total flex credits, and imputed income calculated for a participant enrolled in a plan or option-in-plan.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/costs/{RateValueId}` | Get a cost |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/costs` | Get all costs |

## Benefit Enrollments/Dependents

*The dependents resource is a child of the benefitEnrollments resource. It includes person records that a participant designated as dependents in the context of a program, plan type in program, or plan. The level at which dependent designations occur is defined at the program level for plans-in-program or at the plan level for plans-not-in-program.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/dependents/{CoveredDependentId}` | Get a covered dependent |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/dependents` | Get all covered dependents |

## Benefit Enrollments/Providers

*The providers resource is a child of the benefitEnrollments resource. It includes the external or internal organizations responsible for providing goods or services to the participants of the enrolled plan, such as third party agents and self-insured companies.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/providers/{ProviderOrganizationId}` | Get a plan provider |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/providers` | Get all plan providers |

## Benefit Enrollments/Providers/Provider Roles

*The providerRoles resource is a child of the providers resource. It includes the services or functions performed by an organization to the participants of the enrolled plan.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/providers/{ProviderOrganizationId}/child/providerRoles/{ProviderOrganizationRoleId}` | Get a role |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitEnrollments/{EnrollmentResultId}/child/providers/{ProviderOrganizationId}/child/providerRoles` | Get all roles |

## Benefit Groups

*The benefitGroups resource is used to view, create, modify, or delete a benefits group. It's a setup-side entity in the Benefits product, used to group persons or employees for the participation, election, or maintenance processes. You also use this resource to include or exclude people in benefit plans, options, or rate values through eligibility profile criteria.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitGroups` | Create a benefit group |
| `DELETE` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitGroups/{BenefitGroupName}` | Delete a benefit group |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitGroups/{BenefitGroupName}` | Get a benefit group |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitGroups` | Get all benefit groups |
| `PATCH` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/benefitGroups/{BenefitGroupName}` | Update a benefit group |

## Employees

*The emps resource includes all employees as of the specified date. By default, the current date is retained. This controlled availability resource will be deprecated in the future releases. For implementing new integrations, you're advised to use the workers resource instead. Operations to create and update worker records in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM involve various postprocessing steps across products. Therefore, these operations may take several minutes to complete. For bulk load and extract operations, you must use HCM Data Loader and HCM Extracts, respectively. Also, you must not use REST APIs for detecting data changes in the application. Instead, use Atom feeds to detect or identify changes made to data for key transactions in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM. For example, you may use Atom feeds to detect changes in employee's personal details, employment data, new hires, and terminations. See the Atom Feeds section for details about delivered feeds in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/emps` | Create an employee |

| `PATCH` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/emps/{empsUniqID}` | Update an employee |

## HCM Data Loader Data Sets

*The dataLoadDataSets resource is used to review the details of HCM Data Loader and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader data sets. Actions are supplied to initiate, stop or submit HCM Data Loader and HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader. All actions submit a process to complete the requested action, which may take some time to complete.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}/action/deleteDataSet` | Delete a data set |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}/action/deleteSpreadsheetDataSet` | Delete a spreadsheet data set |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}/action/generateFailedLinesFile` | Generate failed lines files for the business objects within the data set. |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}` | Get a data set |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets` | Get all data sets |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/action/findByAdvancedSearchQuery` | Perform advanced search |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}/action/stop` | Stop data set processing |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/{RequestId}/action/submit` | Submit data set processing |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/action/createFileDataSet` | Submit HCM Data Loader |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/action/createSpreadsheetDataSet` | Submit HCM Spreadsheet Data Loader |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/dataLoadDataSets/action/uploadFile` | Upload file to HDL import account |

## Learner Learning Records

*The learnerLearningRecords resource includes a single assignment or collection of assignments when queried with an assignment record ID. This is a functional user REST resource and applies to a learner and not a learning specialist. The voluntary and required assignments are included for the learning course, specialization, video, or tutorial. Recommended assignments are ignored.*

## Learning Events

*The learningEvents resource represents a single unit of time-based learning. It can be associated with multiple formats, such as in-person or webinar. A learning event is typically configured with a title, a description, and assets, such as cover art and a trailer. It can optionally be configured with learning outcomes, prerequisites, and related materials.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/learningEvents/action/copy` | Copy learning |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/learningEvents` | Create an event |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/learningEvents` | Get all events |

| `PATCH` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/learningEvents/{learningEventsUniqID}` | Update an event |

## Learning Self-Paced Items

*The learningSelfPacedItems resource represents a single unit of learning. It's associated with different types, such as a video, an online course, a document, an assessment, or an observation checklist. A self-paced learning item is typically configured with a title, a description, and assets, such as cover art and a trailer. It can optionally be configured with learning outcomes, prerequisites, and related materials.*

## Locations V2

*The locationsV2 resource provides all the locations as of the specified date. By default, the current date is retained. With this resource, users can retrieve, create, and update the locations. Operations to create and update locations in Oracle HCM Cloud involve various postprocessing steps. Therefore, these operations may take several minutes to complete. For bulk load and extract operations, it's recommended to use HCM Data Loader and HCM Extracts, respectively.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}/action/changeEffectiveStartDate` | Change the effective start date |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/action/splitLocationForChildUpdate` | Create a date-effective update on the job when only a child record is updated |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2` | Create a location |
| `DELETE` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}` | Delete a location |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}/action/deleteLocationOtherAddresses` | Delete the other addresses |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}` | Get a location |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2` | Get all locations |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}/action/modifyLocationRowForChildCorrect` | Mark the location record explicitly as dirty, to be used when only its child data has been modified. |
| `POST` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/action/getReloadedEFFData` | Reload the location extensible flexfield child data |
| `PATCH` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/locationsV2/{locationsV2UniqID}` | Update a location |

## Public Workers

*The publicWorkers resource provides all the active workers as of the current date and returns public information about workers. Worker types include employee, contingent worker, pending worker, and nonworker. For bulk extract operations, you must use HCM Extracts. Also, you must not use REST APIs for detecting data changes in the application. Instead, use Atom feeds to detect or identify changes made to data for key transactions in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM. For example, you may use Atom feeds to detect changes in employee's personal details, employment data, new hires, and terminations. See the Atom Feeds section for details about delivered feeds in Oracle Fusion Cloud HCM.*

| Method | Path | Operation |
|--------|------|-----------|
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/publicWorkers/{PersonId}` | Get a worker |
| `GET` | `/hcmRestApi/resources/11.13.18.05/publicWorkers` | Get all workers |
